newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi, Sweden's Tetra Pak in $12 mln food scheme.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, Sweden's Tetra Pak in $12 mln food scheme.

text.p: Swedish packaging company Tetra Pak and its Saudi agent will setting up a 60 million riyal (US$16 million) plant in the kingdom's city of Jeddah later this year, a London-based Arabic-language newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Swedish firm and Yousef al-Khoseibi Corporation will operate Saudi Arabia Tetra Pak which will produce packaging materials used in the lucrative food-processing sector, Asharq al-Awsat added.
It will focus on manufacturing packaging for scores of Saudi soft drinks, dairy and liquid food processing companies.
The Swedish firm has revolutionised food processing techniques by its multilayered polyethyelene and aluminium foil packaging since its invention in 1951.
The newspaper gave no further details and company officials wer not immediately available for comment.
Oil-rich Saudi Arabia has a population of 18 million.
